name: cboxdk/laravel-cms
description: Cbox CMS monorepo: the kernel packages, the workbench and the development tooling.

check:generated:committed: git diff --exit-code -- workbench/app/Cms/Generated workbench/resources/js/cms/generated || { echo 'The generated code above is not the committed code. Generated code changes only through its schema: edit workbench/schema/fixture.yaml, run cms:generate and commit both.' >&2; exit 1; }

git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- workbench/app/Cms/Generated workbench/resources/js/cms/generated | awk '{ print "Untracked generated file: " $0; n++ } END { if (n > 0) print "Commit what cms:generate writes, and remove files it did not write."; exit n > 0 }'

scripts-descriptions.clear: Reset the Testbench application skeleton in vendor/.
scripts-descriptions.prepare: Discover the packages' service providers for the Testbench application.
scripts-descriptions.test: Run the Pest suite for the monorepo and every package.
scripts-descriptions.services:up: Start PHP 8.5 as the host user, Postgres 18 and Valkey 8 from the main checkout's compose.yaml and wait until they are healthy, then run the idempotent init script again, so an existing data volume gets the current roles and databases. From a linked worktree it starts only Postgres and Valkey, never recreates a container and says that the php container mounts the main checkout. Runs tools/bin/services.php.
scripts-descriptions.services:down: Stop the services from the main checkout's compose.yaml; the data volumes are kept. Refuses with exit 1 in a linked worktree, because the services are shared. Runs tools/bin/services.php.
scripts-descriptions.dev:prepare: Ready the workbench's dev database for cms:doctor, after `composer services:up`, from the main checkout: run the migrations as the owner role on pgsql_owner (cms.database.owner_connection), create the partition runway with cms:partitions:maintain on that connection, and build the registry cache with cms:build. Every step is idempotent; the script stops at a failing step and exits with its code.
scripts-descriptions.lint: Format the PHP code with Pint and the shared configuration from the testkit.
scripts-descriptions.lint:check: Gate 1: fail if Pint would change any file.
scripts-descriptions.rector: Apply the shared Rector sets from the testkit.
scripts-descriptions.rector:check: Gate 2: fail if Rector would change any file.
scripts-descriptions.analyse: Gate 3: PHPStan level 10 with Larastan over the packages, the tests and the workbench, without a baseline.
scripts-descriptions.check: The local profile of GUARDRAILS 10: gates 1 to 6 in order, each marked pass, fail or not run. Exits 1 when a gate fails. Gate 5 needs `composer services:up`. Options after --: --report=<file> writes a JSON report, --brief leaves failed output out of the console.
scripts-descriptions.check:selftest: Plant one known violation per gate in a temporary git worktree of HEAD, run composer check there, and fail unless each gate catches its violation with a path inside the worktree. Removes the worktree afterwards.
scripts-descriptions.check:generated: Gate 6: regenerate the workbench's code from its fixture schema and fail if the generated code differs from the committed code, before or after, or a generated file is untracked (PRD 11.12).
scripts-descriptions.check:generated:committed: Fail if the workbench's generated code has unstaged changes or untracked files.
